headline: 🚨 The weekly report told your Front Beach seller his agreement is extended — on the day it expires, with no receipt anywhere.

notes: 🗞️ The Daily fired at 6:29 AM and produced no letter — second morning running.
📬 Your draft queue went 56 to 5 — you drained it by hand this afternoon.
📵 SMS relay is latent, not dead — two texts landed 43 hours late.

callBlock.why: Emailed **“I have a referral for you”** six minutes after your report, and never said who.
Replied in **40 minutes** on 1406, and it goes live to the public tomorrow.
Filed **Interested: Yes** on Willow Point Monday; flood plain, not price, is her stop.
**HOT** seller lead whose review call has been overdue since March.
He said **“ready to move forward”** on the two parcels and it never happened.
Live buyer, IDX fired 9/2, and you were chasing a specific house for him.
You promised **“I’ll call you myself”** — a Birmingham seller, and nothing tracks it.
Her first email hard-bounced three seconds after send; the phone is her only channel.
